mapper.select: select b.contract_code, case when c.production_status = '已处理' then 3 else 2 end as awaitingStatus from ${invoiceOrderTableName} a inner join ${awaitingTaskDetailsTableName} b on a.primary_key = b.invoice_order INNER JOIN ${sellOrderTableName} c on b.contract_code = c.sell_contract where a.primary_key = #{invoiceOrderCode} and a.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} and a.delete_flag = false
